hold_text: Touches .github/workflows/research-queue-dispatch.yml (the dispatcher's land job): a new continue-on-error step that pushes merges to, or closes, the bot's own automation/research-queue-stamp* PRs. The manager merges.
why: AUTOMATION-DATACOMMIT-CONFLICT (owner AM-OPS-7; the manager approved the design 2026-11-19: regenerate/resolve on fresh main, superseded stamp PRs close themselves). ROOT CAUSE, measured in land job 135462990269 of run 44492257802: the stamp landing runs commit-to-main with verify-merged "false", so commit-to-main's stale-branch refresh, the only caller of scripts/ops/resolve_stamp_conflicts.py, never reaches a stamp PR. A stamp PR beaten to main by a later stamp sat conflicted until the 6h stale-closer (7 of 11 stale open automation PRs in the 48h measurement). FIX: scripts/research/refresh_stamp_prs.py runs each cycle in a separate worktree. For each open stamp PR GitHub reports mergeable=false: merge main, resolve with the existing resolver (later stamp wins, a cleared stamp beats a stamp, a non-stamp conflict is refused and aborted). Then CLOSE as superseded with a pointer when the branch no longer changes any research/queue unit vs main; otherwise push the refresh so its armed auto-merge lands it. Per-PR containment, never fails the job, an unreadable listing prints 'could not look'. Listing uses GITHUB_TOKEN (the PAT's REST budget is exhausted at times, see ACTIONS-QUEUE-BACKLOG); the push uses the checkout's PAT so checks run. Tests: tests/test_refresh_stamp_prs.py against real temp git repos (older stamp: superseded; newer stamp: refreshed, pushed, and now a descendant of main; a non-stamp conflict: refused, branch and tree untouched) plus the wiring test; with the 20 test files that reference research-queue-dispatch.yml: 211 passed. Results-batch conflicts (the 8th case, #27244) are already bounded: the 90-min closer plus re-collect from main. The receipt case was fixed earlier by the 'every receipt but the newest' closer. No trader file touched (decide: SKIP). Revert: git revert. Gates this adds or changes: none.
